text:
Zoe Patel: Hey team, quick onboarding issues: monitor arrived with a DisplayPort cable but my laptop only has USB-C PD input, and the included USB-C to USB-A adapter didn't come. Also trying to connect to the VPN yields "certificate required" on connection and my MFA code is rejected. Anyone know who to ping?
Becky (People Ops): welcome Zoe! @Zoe Patel tag IT here. DM the tracking number if you can and well sort logistics.
Paul_IT: Hi Zoe 44b Im Paul from IT. Sorry about the cable. Can you DM the monitor serial and the box tracking? For the VPN/MFA: are you using the company Auth app or SMS codes? And what OS are you on?
Zoe Patel: Tracking: 1Z555AA98765432100. Monitor serial: RWD-MN-7B2C9. Using Auth app on Android, macOS Ventura 13.4. VPN error: "OpenVPN: TLS key negotiation failed - certificate required". MFA shows "invalid code" when I paste from the app.
it-bot: Ticket created: INC-2026-0523 (assigned to it_support).
Paul_IT: Thanks. Two quick steps: 1) For VPN cert, download the org root cert from https://intranet.redwood.dev/it/root-cert and install to System Keychain (set to Always Trust), then restart VPN client. 2) For MFA, open the Auth app, tap the account and choose "Sync time" or re-scan the QR from https://id.redwood.dev/mfa-regen if you have the recovery. If still failing, I can issue a one-time bypass code for you.
Zoe Patel: Installed the root cert and restarted the VPN client 604 Attempting auth now... VPN connected! :tada: Auth app still giving invalid code though.
Paul_IT: Good on the VPN. For MFA, I pushed a one-time bypass to the ticket (code sent via secure email). Use that to sign in and then re-enroll your Auth app.
Zoe Patel: Used bypass, re-enrolled the app, MFA working now. Thanks.
Paul_IT: For the monitor cable and USB-C adapter, I've scheduled a replacement kit (USB-C cable + powered USB-C dock) shipped expedited, tracking will be emailed. ETA 1 business day. Leaving the ticket open for hardware.
Becky (People Ops): Welcome aboard Zoe! Let us know if you want an extra keyboard or mouse in the box.
Zoe Patel: All set, appreciate the fast help everyone!
